svg.text: Bringing a sacred language into the digital age
Spoken by the Dawoodi Bohra community worldwide
Written in Arabic script with unique extra characters
Used in religious texts, poetry, and everyday speech
No native digital typing tools existed — until now
A common phrase in Lisan ud Dawat
ض ص ث ق ف غ ع ه
A full Lisan ud Dawat keyboard for iPhone
All 30+ LSD characters, including ٹ ڈ چ پ گ ھ
Three layers: letters · diacritics · numbers & symbols
Hold any key to see alternate characters
Transliteration: converts LSD script ↔ Roman alphabet
The keyboard reads what you type in Lisan ud Dawat and suggests
the Roman alphabet spelling — useful for sharing with non-LSD readers.
The community improves the model — without sharing private text
Uploading personal documents or sermons is not required. Your words stay on your phone.
updated model sent back to everyone's keyboard automatically
🔒 Your original text never leaves your device — ever
Crowdsourcing a Lisan ud Dawat corpus — with your consent
Separately from model training, you can help build an open library of LSD word pairs.
You review every single pair on screen before anything is shared.
of LSD words and their Roman
equivalents — free for all to use
Community project · Privacy-first · No text ever leaves your device without your approval
